Four Verizon Prepaid Unlimited lines cost **$180/month** without the Auto Pay discount. That figure comes from the Verizon Prepaid plans page (verizon.com/plans/prepaid/) with 4 lines selected and Auto Pay switched off.

- The price already includes a $60/mo multiline discount.
- With Auto Pay on, the same four lines are $140/mo ($35 per line).
- The other plans at 4 lines without Auto Pay are 15 GB at $180/mo and Unlimited Plus at $220/mo.
- Taxes and fees are extra.

The Auto Pay toggle only changed after a delay, so the page looked unchanged for a few attempts before it showed "Off".
